hints.title: Only Two Distinct Characters
hints.text: The string consists only of characters a and b. A subsequence does not need to be contiguous.

hints.title: Check Whole String Palindrome
hints.text: If s is already a palindrome, you can remove the entire string in 1 operation.

hints.title: At Most Two Operations
hints.text: Otherwise, remove all character a instances in one operation (all same letters form a palindrome) and all b instances in the second.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying complicated state searches over-complicates an invariant that at most two operations are ever needed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking if s equals its reverse takes linear time and constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes that subsequences need not be contiguous and identical characters always form palindromes.
